verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance stores corporate records, licenses, and tax data, so retention and deletion controls are a fair question for it, but the evidence documents no retention policies, retention windows, or user-facing data deletion or export-and-purge controls. The only related item says API delete operations need capabilities that Harbor Compliance must explicitly grant. That is an access-permission gate on resource deletion, not a user-controllable retention or deletion capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Creating, updating, and deleting resources requires additional capabilities which Harbor Compliance must explicitly grant to your account
